table_description: Physical retail store dimension. Each row describes one store location version (SCD Type 2 — store attributes like manager or hours can change over time, creating new rows). Contains store geography, size, staffing, market, and tax information. Join from STORE_SALES and STORE_RETURNS via their SS_STORE_SK / SR_STORE_SK columns.
use_cases: Store size (floor space) correlation with revenue
Tax rate analysis by store location
Market and division level rollup reporting
data_quality_notes: STORE is SCD Type 2 — S_REC_END_DATE IS NULL identifies the current active record for each store.
S_STORE_ID is the business key — multiple rows with the same S_STORE_ID represent the same physical store at different points in time.
S_CLOSED_DATE_SK is NULL for open stores. A non-NULL value means the store has closed.
S_TAX_PRECENTAGE is the store's sales tax rate (note: typo in column name — 'PRECENTAGE' not 'PERCENTAGE'). It's a decimal (e.g. 0.08 = 8%).
S_HOURS is a text description of store operating hours.
S_NUMBER_EMPLOYEES is headcount at the store.

table_columns.name: S_STORE_SK
table_columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Referenced by STORE_SALES.SS_STORE_SK and STORE_RETURNS.SR_STORE_SK.

table_columns.name: S_STORE_ID
table_columns.description: Business key. Same physical store across SCD versions shares this ID.

table_columns.name: S_REC_START_DATE
table_columns.description: Start of this store record's validity (SCD Type 2).

table_columns.name: S_REC_END_DATE
table_columns.description: End of validity. NULL = currently active store record.

table_columns.name: S_CLOSED_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM. NULL if store is open. Non-NULL if store has closed.

table_columns.name: S_NUMBER_EMPLOYEES
table_columns.description: Number of employees at this store.

table_columns.name: S_FLOOR_SPACE
table_columns.description: Store floor space in square feet.

table_columns.name: S_MARKET_MANAGER
table_columns.description: Name of the regional market manager.

table_columns.name: S_TAX_PRECENTAGE
table_columns.description: Sales tax rate as decimal (e.g. 0.08 = 8%). Note: column name has a typo — 'PRECENTAGE'.
